newsitem.title: UK: FKI says expects further profit growth.
newsitem.headline: FKI says expects further profit growth.

text.p: British engineering group FKI Plc said on Thursday it had started the year well and expected to sustain substantial and profitable growth.
"We have made a strong start...order books are at record levels. I remain optimistic of another satisfactory year of earnings growth," chief executive Bob Beeston said in a statement.
In the year to March 31, 1997, pre-tax profit rose 24.4 percent to 112.1 million stg.
Beeston said FKI expected to derive an increasing part of its earnings from organic growth.
He said the company had reaped productivity gains from its investment in manufacturing technology.
Beeston said FKI, which earlier this year failed in its bid to take over building products group Newman Tonks Group Plc, would continue to look for acquisitions.
